title: accounts.yaml: an empty chatgpt: map is accepted; rows are read
notes: Writing order and bytes are asserted in provider-21 and format-11, which need a login.

rows.label: empty map
rows.doc:
# Kogen accounts on this machine, written by kogen provider use.
chatgpt: {}

rows.label: rows
rows.doc:
# Kogen accounts on this machine, written by kogen provider use.
chatgpt:
  default: work
  projects:
    - path: "{checkout}"
      account: work

expect.stdout_regex:
\A(environment/invalid_accounts_file: {home}/\.kogen/accounts\.yaml is not valid; fix or delete it|provider/login: chatgpt:work has no saved login; run kogen provider login chatgpt --as work)
\Z
